typography.family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
rules: no hero or marketing sentence above useful financial information
only task names or compact descriptions in headings
money never cropped or truncated without an accessible complete value

desktopHome: Four concise KPI cells, first is available-to-spend, then cash, upcoming, spent
Prioritize needs-attention panel to left and large spending-pace chart to right at 1440px
Budget-progress panel before activity list below main analysis row
No generic overview hero, chat panel or ornamental animation
desktopActivity: Ledger is primary with dense rows and compact filters
Optional detail pane on selection, stable URL, view supports >1000 rows
Native table semantics, keyboard focus, account/category/currency visible when relevant
desktopReceipt: Editable extraction/details in the left content column, original receipt image visible alongside
Crop/review original and matching are distinguishable steps
Never post a duplicate ledger expense on match
mobileHome: Money immediately visible, with cash and upcoming below
Needs attention, activity, and entry actions beneath, no stacked promotional cards
Bottom bar Home Activity Scan Plan Explore; More/account always discoverable
mobileScan: Camera-first fullscreen work area, visible capture control and gallery fallback
Page thumbnails, quality, crop/rotate and processing status in P30
Draft storage disclosed; no simulated camera in production
mobilePlan: Budget/Goals/Recurring accessible as full screen contexts
Summary with planned/spent/remaining and rows showing category progress
Do not force eight-column data table on mobile
stateSpecimens: Receipt OCR processing, no finance mutation

semantics.positive: posted positive or confirmed improvement, never a receipt-processing indicator
semantics.negative: posted outflow/overrun or explicit negative value
semantics.accent: focus and selected navigation, not for meaningless ornamental icons
semantics.caution: The direction is dark-first, not neon-first; avoid glow effects, abundant saturated panels or generic fintech-dashboard styling

motion.reducedMotion: 0.01ms; no essential action depends on animation

accessibility.WCAG: 2.2 AA target for implemented UI; static mockup scan is not certification
accessibility.screenReader: Required in P39; cannot be inferred from static design mockups
